result.instructions: Tools for Disqus, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show the comments on my Disqus forum that wait for approval."; "Which threads on my site got the most new comments this week?"; "Mark these three comments as spam and close the thread they are in.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Disqus data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run disqus_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run disqus_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run disqus_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. disqus_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: disqus_get_forum
tools.title: Get forum
tools.description: Get the details of one Disqus forum (site): name, settings, founder and counters.

forum.description: Forum short name (the Disqus 'shortname', for example 'bobross').

tools.name: disqus_list_forum_threads
tools.title: List forum threads
tools.description: List the threads (pages with comments) of a forum, newest first by default.

forum.description: Forum short name (the Disqus 'shortname', for example 'bobross').

since.description: Only items after this Unix timestamp or ISO datetime.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor: the 'cursor.next' value of the previous call.

tools.name: disqus_list_forum_posts
tools.title: List forum comments
tools.description: List the comments of a forum, newest first by default. Use 'include' to read unapproved, spam or flagged comments (needs moderator rights).

forum.description: Forum short name (the Disqus 'shortname', for example 'bobross').

since.description: Only items after this Unix timestamp or ISO datetime.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor: the 'cursor.next' value of the previous call.

tools.name: disqus_list_posts
tools.title: List comments
tools.description: List comments across the forums the account moderates (or the forums given), by date. Filter by thread, date range or state.

forum.description: Forum short name. Default: all forums the account moderates.

start.description: Only items after this Unix timestamp or ISO datetime.

end.description: Only items before this Unix timestamp or ISO datetime.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor: the 'cursor.next' value of the previous call.

tools.name: disqus_get_thread
tools.title: Get thread

forum.description: Forum short name. Needed with 'thread_ident' or 'thread_link'.

tools.name: disqus_approve_posts
tools.title: Approve comments
tools.description: WRITE: approve held comments so they show on the site. The account must moderate the forum.

tools.name: disqus_mark_posts_spam
tools.title: Mark comments as spam
tools.description: WRITE: mark comments as spam. They leave the public thread. The account must moderate the forum.

tools.name: disqus_delete_posts
